actorCandidates.name: photorealPlayerCycle
actorCandidates.prompt: Create a production game animation atlas, exactly FOUR columns by FIVE rows, twenty separate complete full-body figures in a rigid regular grid. Transparent background and transparent gutters. All figures photographed with the SAME fixed orthographic isometric camera roughly30degrees above, soft warm upper-left light, photoreal skin and fabric, same identity/proportions/scale/clothes in every cell. Columns: FRONT, facing RIGHT three-quarter side, BACK, facing LEFT three-quarter side. Rows: row1 STANDING idle; row2 LEFT FOOT forward contact with right leg back; row3 passing pose with RIGHT KNEE lifting through, feet close; row4 RIGHT FOOT forward contact with left leg back; row5 passing pose with LEFT KNEE lifting through. Each row must be anatomically and visibly different, and walking must alternate actual opposite legs and opposite arm swing. Match body/head position and ground baseline exactly; shoes at92percent cellheight, body height80percent, all arms and shoes entirely inside their own cell, clear consistent cell margins. NO empty cells, missing figures, duplicate phase rows, row captions, text, numbers, labels, frames, borders, floor or watermark. A game sprite sheet, not an illustration of a room. Reference image1 is the original Spectrum front cover: use its right-panel man as visual authority. Reference image2 is the already-approved derived character and locks his recognizable FACE and OUTFIT. Keep his pale narrow expressive face, messy short LIGHT BLOND hair, manic open-mouthed grin, raised eyebrows, thin build, BLACK suit jacket, WHITE shirt, narrow dark patterned TIE, BLACK BRACES/suspenders over shirt, loose black suit trousers and BLACK leather shoes. Idle recalls cover's wide open hands; walking arms swing more naturally while retaining his irreverent expression. No leather jacket, no brown shoes, no dark hair, no alternative identity. Preserve the exact same man throughout all twenty cells.

contactCandidates.prompt: Photoreal transparent game WALK PAIR, exactly TWO full-body figures side by side in equal cells, both facing FRONT, same camera/identity/clothes/scale. Reference image1 is the approved character sheet: preserve that blond cover man's exact face, messy blond hair, manic open-mouth grin, BLACK suit jacket, WHITE shirt, patterned dark tie, BLACK BRACES, black trousers and black leather shoes. Reference image2 is an ANATOMICAL POSE GUIDE and is the primary authority for leg and arm positions: the left figure (A) advances his anatomical LEFT leg, with the RIGHT leg behind; the right figure (B) advances his anatomical RIGHT leg, with the LEFT leg behind. Follow the red LEFT and blue RIGHT limb chains in the guide, but REMOVE all guide colours/labels from the final black-clothed photographs. The lead/support leg MUST genuinely swap between A and B, not be the same leg with different bends. Both arms must also swap reciprocal swing: left leg forward/right arm forward in A; right leg forward/left arm forward in B. For side views, preserve which leg is nearer the camera and visibly swap its forward/back position. Keep both soles on a coherent ground plane, knees anatomically connected to the correct hips, torso/head upright and unchanged. Think of A and B as two opposite contact frames HALF A WALK CYCLE APART, not two variants of a left step. Do not mirror the whole person or reuse a pose. Use actual distinct photographs/poses with consistent perspective, light and body proportions. Fixed orthographic miniature game photography, slightly elevated camera, soft warm upper-left light. Generous transparent margins around both complete figures, no crops, no floor/backdrop, no text, labels, skeleton, coloured limbs, borders, watermarks or extra people.

acceptedRightContactPrompt: Create ONE full-body photoreal transparent game sprite of the cover man in reference: messy light blond hair, manic wide open mouth, black suit and trousers, white shirt, patterned dark tie, braces, black shoes. Exact RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE (nose points IMAGE RIGHT). Walking contact pose with CAMERA-NEAR RIGHT ARM swung strongly FORWARD toward IMAGE RIGHT: the entire large visible right sleeve crosses IN FRONT OF HIS CHEST and the right hand is in front of his sternum, clearly to IMAGE RIGHT of his belly, bent elbow. CAMERA-NEAR RIGHT LEG trails BACK toward IMAGE LEFT, near shoe left of hips; FAR LEFT LEG extends forward toward IMAGE RIGHT, shoe right of hips. FAR LEFT ARM swings behind him IMAGE LEFT. The visible near hand MUST be forward, not dangling behind his buttock. The reference pose has its near arm swung back: SWAP that near arm forward and swap the leg lead. Keep man facing right; do not mirror him. Natural reciprocal walking anatomy, two clearly separated shoes touching same ground baseline, head upright. ONE figure only. Entire body isolated with generous transparent margin, no floor, shadow, background, text or diagram.
